name: Vanquish ME
lead: Vanquish ME is a non-contact, hands-free body-contouring device made by BTL Industries that uses selective radiofrequency (RF) energy to heat fat tissue and reduce abdominal fat thickness.[1] People use it as a non-surgical option to slim the waist, abdomen and thighs without needles, incisions or contact applicators.

In a multi-centre randomised study of 36 subjects with BMIs under 30, each person received four weekly 45-minute treatments, and the Vanquish ME group had an abdominal fat thickness reduction of 4.17 mm, or 29.46%, on ultrasound one month after the last session.[1] The study compared it with its predecessor, the original Vanquish, which the ME system was redesigned to improve on for more efficient and homogeneous energy delivery.[1]
A separate clinical evaluation looked at a selective RF applicator for reducing thigh circumference.[2]

chain: Selective RF heats subcutaneous fat from a distance
Fat layer thins over a series of sessions
angle.text: Vanquish ME is used in clinics for a series of sessions aimed at a smaller waist and thigh circumference. It works through a panel held over the body rather than touching the skin.

paras: The device delivers radiofrequency energy through a hands-free applicator aimed at the target area, so treatment is non-contact and non-invasive.[1] In the published abdominal protocol, subjects had four weekly 45-minute sessions and were measured by ultrasound four weeks afterward.[1]

The randomised comparison with the original Vanquish reported a 4.17 mm (29.46%) reduction in abdominal fat thickness in the ME group, with 34 of 36 subjects completing and the two dropouts reported as unrelated to the study.[1] Another clinical study evaluated a selective RF applicator for reducing thigh circumference.[2]
The two published device studies above are the main peer-reviewed sources found; both involve the manufacturer's platform.

timeline.event: Clinical evaluations of the Vanquish ME system and a selective RF thigh applicator are published.[1][2]

card.summary: A hands-free radiofrequency device that heats fat to slim the abdomen and thighs over a short series of clinic sessions, with no contact or incisions.
card.note: Results measured in small manufacturer-linked studies; clinic pricing varies.

quick.overview:
Vanquish ME is a BTL Industries body-contouring machine that uses selective radiofrequency energy delivered without touching the skin.

It is used for the abdomen and thighs, usually as a series of weekly sessions in an aesthetic clinic.
quick.mechanism: Radiofrequency energy is aimed at the treatment area to warm subcutaneous fat selectively. In one study, abdominal fat thickness measured by ultrasound fell by an average of 4.17 mm after four weekly 45-minute treatments.
quick.risks: The published studies describe a non-invasive procedure with no incisions. Study sizes were small, and long-term outcomes were not reported in the sources found.
